name: @osmargm1202/pi-harness
description: Instalador standalone para el stack de ORGM (one-shot + instalación por paquetes).

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const path = require('node:path'); const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const pkg = process.env.npm_package_json; if (!pkg) process.exit(0); const script = path.join(path.dirname(pkg), 'scripts', 'install-orgm-pi-packages.mjs'); const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [script, '--postinstall'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 0);"
